description: The three LP-0008 category agents (storage, messaging, blockchain) each settle on the public testnet through their own skill dispatch: the agent deploys the deterministic sample claimer program once, each agent invokes program.call with a declared zero spend against a fresh public account, and the account's ownership flip to the program is read back from chain state. All six RPC snapshots below were fetched after the run as independent re-verification.
verification: getTransaction returns full data for each hash; getAccount returns program_owner = [4149507475, 2899875356, 3533181665, 187577555, 1635646031, 390871547, 143435526, 1906593423] (the deployed program id as eight little-endian u32 words) and nonce 1 for each claimed account
